taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: VPN gateway identity/posture mapping into tunnel and resource authority
controls.source_trace: Trace issuer authentication context into VPN authorization and session refresh/reconnect, including local fallback identities.
controls.implementation_branch: Map federated assertion assurance to the gateway session, device posture and resource policy. The IdP session and the VPN tunnel can have different documented lifetimes. A valid SSO response alone does not demonstrate internal network access; confirm only the owned permitted service path and classify revocation delay against the declared contract.
controls.operational_method: Specialize in one supplied gateway/protocol profile: assertion/token validation, mapped local VPN role, device/posture identity, tunnel issuance and permitted resource ACL. Compare the IdP identity/assurance with the actual tunnel/session record and one owned service access result, including reassessment on reconnect or posture change where the contract requires it. A generic SAML fixture cannot define gateway enforcement; absent gateway mapping is an explicit blocker, not proof of internal access.
controls.controlled_verification: Using supplied gateway mappings or an owned gateway fixture, trace one synthetic federation identity and posture result into local VPN role, tunnel issuance and one permitted resource. Compare an assurance/posture mismatch or revoked reconnect under the actual profile.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A successful IdP login or missing UI MFA prompt does not prove gateway assurance downgrade; the assertion/session may already carry required assurance.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind federation context and gateway session policy, verifying intended reconnect and required assurance.
